decision.observation: 11:50 am; bobber unchanged in the pond, no 'HIT!' cue in this cast for many minutes of nibbles.
decision.hypothesis: Long casts after many nibbles may stop producing bites; reeling in and recasting (C twice) resets the bite timer at this known-good spot.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, ignore nibbles, press C at 'HIT!', then hold/release LMB to keep the green bar on the fish. Sunfish caught this way on day 5.
